## Earnie 2.5.1

Official **PATCH** after **2.5.0**. Focus: live telemetry robustness, Chart 1 / SoC consistency, and Loxone auth recovery.

### Highlights

- **Chart 1 SoC** — history sanitization no longer chains stale high ESS readings when viewing past S-2 cycles; repeated ESS plateaus and integration contradictions are handled
- **Dead live telemetry** — all-zero EHAL/Loxone meter snapshots are skipped in the optimizer matrix and history chart rows; load is held forward after poisoned slots
- **Loxone auth** — HTTP 401/403 pauses Loxone polling to avoid Miniserver timeouts; Streamlit surfaces an auth recovery banner and `.env` credential update path

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.1`
- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:latest`
- Legacy aliases: `ghcr.io/jochentcc/ernie-energy:2.5.1` / `:latest`

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

Deploy: [docs/einrichtung/container.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/docs/einrichtung/container.md)

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology_productive.yml up -d
```

(Same pattern for `loxberry_productive.yml` / `proxmox_productive.yml`.)

See [backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md](https://github.com/JochenTCC/Earnie/blob/main/backlog/Backlog-Bugfixes.md).
